terminology_decisions: GameHQ, GameInput, XInput, DualSense, HDR, FPS, Steam, Playnite, GitHub, API names, paths, commands, shortcut keys, placeholders, and versions remain unchanged.
Korean uses 컨트롤러, 버튼, 할당, 슬롯, and 입력; controller input listening never uses media-capture terminology.
Press is immediate 누르기; release-based Tap is 짧게 누르기; 두 번 누르기, 세 번 누르기, and 길게 누르기 remain distinct, and completed Hold suppresses Tap.
리플레이 names the feature, 리플레이 버퍼 its rolling recording, 클립 a saved video, 녹화 the recording process, and 재생 ordinary playback.
스크린샷, 캡처, 갤러리, 라이브러리, 오버레이, and 알림 영역 denote distinct product concepts.
Update security uses 매니페스트, 체크섬, 서명, 준비, 트랜잭션, 신뢰 상태, and 데이터 손상.
Portable import uses 포터블, 준비된, 저널, 문자열, 루트, 원본, 인스턴스, 데이터베이스, and 외래 키; portable:/ stays literal.
Korean uses one Qt numerus form while preserving explicit quantities and counters.
Controls use concise action forms; explanatory sentences use consistent polite Korean and natural spacing.
Korean particles attach directly to protected Latin-script names; independent nouns and version tokens remain separated.
Internal staging publish operations use finalization or application wording; 게시 remains only for genuine publication.
calibration_rules: Review every stable ID with its English source, location, control role, and neighboring UI; schema validity is not linguistic evidence.
Use concise controls and idiomatic polite Korean for explanatory prose.
Preserve placeholders, protected identifiers, shortcut keys, button names, paths, commands, punctuation tokens, and versions.
Review application, installer, Playnite, native launcher, startup, and release-note surfaces separately.
Resolve capture, replay, controller input, filesystem, database, and update-security terms from product context.
Avoid touchscreen touch terminology for controller-button gestures and preserve activation timing.
